2. This is applicant's second application under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as the applicant is implicated in connection with Crime No.499/2022, registered at Police Station - Station Road, District Ratlam for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 109 of the IPC.

sentences.text: 3. First application bearing M.Cr.C.No.50077/2022 was dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 31.10.2022 with liberty to renew the prayer at an appropriate stage.

4. As per the prosecution, the complainant Imran Khan lodged a complaint to the effect that co-accused Shakil is running a passport and visa office and has taken money from him and similarly situated persons with a promise of sending them to Kuwait for jobs.

sentences.text: The allegation against the applicant is that he is the father of co-accused Shakil Khan and had allured the complainants to deposit the money with the co- accused assuring that he would send them to Kuwait and in case of his failure to do so he shall return the money to them.
Since the complainants were not sent to Kuwait they asked for refund of their amount which was not paid to them by the accused.
On the basis of the complaint made by the complainants, the applicant has been implicated and arrested for the present offence.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
There is no allegation against him of running the business of taking money from the complainants with the promise of sending them to Kuwait by getting them jobs.
The said allegation is on co- accused Shakil Khan.

The only allegation against the applicant is that being father of co-accused Shakil Khan he had allured the complainants to deposit money with Shakil stating that in case they are not sent to Kuwait and money is not returned to the complainants he would do the same.
Complainants have been refunded the amount which they had deposited with the co-accused and they do not have any objection in case of grant of bail to the applicant.
It is further submitted that the applicant is in custody since 22.7.2022 and trial is likely to take time for its conclusion.
On such grounds, prayer for grant of bail to the applicant has been made.

6. The aforesaid prayer has been opposed by the learned counsel for the non-applicant/State submitting that in view of the allegation levelled against the applicant, he is not entitled to be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the complainants / objectors submits that the complainants have no objection in case for grant of bail to the applicant.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and have perused the case diary as well as the record.

8. The allegation against the applicant is of assuring the complainants that in case his son co-accused Shakil Khan does not send them to Kuwait by finding jobs for them and does not return their amount, he would do the same but has not done the same on refusal by Shakil Khan to return the amount to them.
The main allegation is against Shakil Khan of taking money from the complainants on pretext of providing them jobs in Kuwait but not sending them over there and not returning their money to them.
Applicant is in custody since 22.7.2022 and the trial is likely to take time for its conclusion.
Thus in view of the role attributed to the applicant in the present matter and looking to the period of his custody, I deem it fit to enlarge him on bail.
9. Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the Court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
10.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
